label: Grim Reaper patchwork controls checked
description: The local-pieces and patchwork premises are independent and neither alone excludes a beginningless past: in the beginningless integer history, silent registers satisfy both patchwork premises and neither local premise, and pivot registers satisfy both local premises and neither patchwork premise; populated pasts there are neither founded nor begun. So the conclusion is reached only through the derivation, not through either premise. In a history with a first moment followed by moments with no earliest one, the coinitial premises, countable coinitiality, begun populated pasts and the earlier-grounded possibility all hold together with possible begun coming-to-be and no necessary concrete individual, while no register frame satisfies both unrestricted premises: the unrestricted version excludes that history and the coinitial version does not. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
